title: Schedule a standard domestic flight
why: Confirms a fully valid flight is accepted and stored with the supplied route, price, and status.

steps.does: POST …/flight with FlightNumber FL-1001, AircraftId aircraft-1, DepartureAirportId airport-jfk, ArriveAirportId airport-bos, DurationMinutes 75, Price 120.50, Status Flying, DepartureDate 2026-11-10T08:00, ArriveDate 2026-11-10T09:15, FlightDate 2026-11-10

expect: Success: a Flight is created with a new Id and the submitted values, and the response echoes them.
